title: Pelagos Global Bunker & Voyage Economics Source Discovery Inventory
author: Pelagos Core Intelligence & Optimization Team

sources.dataset_name: Bunker Fuel Prices Public REST API (v1)
sources.geographic_coverage: 22 active ports in public response (includes USHOU, SGSIN, NLRTM, AEFJR, KRPUS, CNSGH, CNZOS, GIGIB, MTMLA, DKSKA, ARBUE, USNYC, USLAX). Excludes USSEA, USPDX, USMSY, JPYOK.
sources.historical_coverage: Current spot indications only; no public historical endpoint provided. 155 of 209 records withheld.
sources.units_and_currency: Nominally USD/MT. Critical data integrity finding: Chinese ports (CNSGH, CNZOS) pass through upstream CNY figures (e.g. 5473 CNY, 6028 CNY) mislabeled as usdPerMt.
sources.rate_limits: Unspecified; automated bulk extraction prohibited by terms of service
sources.licence_status: Terms of Service Section 05 explicitly prohibits extracting data in bulk for competing services. Upstream feed from OilPriceAPI (licensed:oilpriceapi).

corridor_relevance.USG-JPN-BULK: PARTIAL (Houston USHOU covered; New Orleans USMSY and Yokohama JPYOK unavailable)

sources.limitations_and_gaps: Severe currency mismatch on Chinese ports; 74% of records withheld; lacks PNW (Seattle/Portland), Mississippi River (New Orleans), and Japan (Yokohama); terms restrict automated commercial redistribution.

sources.operator: U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS)
sources.geographic_coverage: Global 20-Port Average composite index (Busan, Colombo, Durban, Fujairah, Gibraltar, Hong Kong, Houston, Istanbul, LA/Long Beach, Las Palmas, Mumbai, New York, Panama, Piraeus, Rotterdam, Santos, Shanghai, Singapore, St Petersburg, Tokyo). Individual port breakdowns not provided.
sources.update_frequency: Originally daily; currently discontinued/static historical archive
sources.access_method: Socrata Open Data API (SODA REST JSON, CSV, OData)
sources.rate_limits: Standard Socrata public API limits (app token recommended for high volume)
sources.licence_status: U.S. Government Open Data / Public Domain. Attribution: Ship & Bunker.

corridor_relevance.PNW-JPN-BULK: UNAVAILABLE (global composite only; no port-specific PNW or Japan quote)
corridor_relevance.USG-JPN-BULK: UNAVAILABLE (global composite only; no port-specific USG quote)

sources.limitations_and_gaps: Composite average across 20 ports cannot be substituted for actual delivered port quotes; data series discontinued after November 2022.

sources.dataset_name: Ship & Bunker Global Port Price Intelligence & Spot Indices
fields_observed: Grade (VLSFO, MGO, IFO380, ULSFO, Bio-Bunkers B24/B30, LNG)
sources.geographic_coverage: Over 150 ports globally, including Houston (USHOU), New York, Los Angeles, Singapore (SGSIN), Rotterdam (NLRTM), Fujairah (AEFJR), Tokyo/Yokohama (JPYOK), and Panama (PAPAC Balboa/Cristobal). Seattle and Portland have limited/intermittent secondary indications.
sources.historical_coverage: 2012 to present (full historical archive available via commercial data suite)
sources.access_method: Public web portal (HTML view); commercial REST API & CSV download via Ship & Bunker Data Suite
sources.authentication_required: Free web access for current daily indications; subscription required for API / bulk historical access
sources.rate_limits: Commercial API subject to contracted tier
sources.licence_status: LICENSE_RESTRICTED (proprietary assessed data; terms prohibit automated scraping or redistribution without data license)

corridor_relevance.PNW-JPN-BULK: PARTIAL (Yokohama JPYOK available daily; Seattle/Portland covered sporadically or via US West Coast index)
corridor_relevance.USG-JPN-BULK: VERIFIED (Houston USHOU, Panama PAPAC, and Yokohama JPYOK directly covered)

sources.limitations_and_gaps: Delivered physical prices are assessments, not confirmed supplier sales stems; programmatic ingestion requires commercial data license.

sources.dataset_name: OilPriceAPI Marine Bunker Fuels API Endpoint
sources.geographic_coverage: Global major hubs (Singapore, Rotterdam, Fujairah, Houston, Gibraltar, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Zhoushan, Buenos Aires). Pacific Northwest (Seattle/Portland) largely absent.
sources.historical_coverage: Historical daily time-series available to paid subscribers
sources.units_and_currency: Nominally USD/MT, but currency metadata inconsistencies observed on Chinese ports where CNY values are labeled as USD
sources.rate_limits: 100 requests/month on free tier; paid tiers from $29 to $299/month for higher limits
sources.licence_status: Commercial API terms; redistribution governed by license tier

corridor_relevance.USG-JPN-BULK: PARTIAL (Houston USHOU covered; New Orleans USMSY and Yokohama JPYOK unverified/absent)

sources.limitations_and_gaps: Requires paid API key; upstream feed responsible for the currency label anomaly identified in bunkerfuelprices.com; lacks PNW coverage.

sources.operator: Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA)
sources.dataset_name: MPA Monthly Bunker Sales Statistics & Licensed Bunker Suppliers Register
fields_observed: Bunker Sales Volume by Fuel Type (Metric Tonnes)
Bunker Grade Categories (LSFO, HSFO, MGO, Biofuels, LNG)
sources.units_and_currency: Sales volume in Metric Tonnes (MT). Commercial transaction prices are NOT published.
sources.access_method: Web download (CSV / Excel via data.gov.sg and MPA web portal)
sources.limitations_and_gaps: Does not publish bunker prices; confirms that statutory port authorities regulate standards (SS 648 / TR 48) and track volume, but leave fuel pricing to private commercial markets.

sources.operator: European Commission / European Maritime Safety Agency (EMSA)
sources.dataset_name: THETIS-MRV Public Emissions & Fuel Consumption Dataset (Regulation (EU) 2015/757 & 2023/1805)
fields_observed: Total Fuel Consumption by Grade (HFO, LFO, MGO, LNG in metric tonnes)
Annual Average Fuel Consumption per Distance (kg/nm)
Annual Average Fuel Consumption per Transport Work (g/t-nm)
sources.geographic_coverage: Global commercial fleet calling European Economic Area (EEA) ports (12,000+ vessels annually)
sources.historical_coverage: 2018 to present (annual reporting periods released by June 30 each year)
sources.units_and_currency: Metric tonnes of fuel, metric tonnes of CO2, nautical miles, hours, gCO2/t-nm
sources.access_method: Direct public bulk download (XLSX / CSV) and web interface; no login required
sources.licence_status: Public sector data / European Union Open Access

corridor_relevance.PNW-JPN-BULK: PARTIAL (covers bulk carriers that have called EEA ports; provides annual baseline verification)
corridor_relevance.USG-JPN-BULK: PARTIAL (covers bulk carriers that have called EEA ports; provides annual baseline verification)

sources.limitations_and_gaps: Reports vessel-reported annual aggregated consumption (Category 2), NOT per-voyage or operational speed-consumption curves (e.g. 12 knots ballast vs 14 knots laden); restricted to vessels with at least one EEA port call during the reporting year.

sources.dataset_name: MAN CEAS Engine Calculation & Application System
fields_observed: Specified Maximum Continuous Rating (SMCR kW and RPM)
Specific Fuel Oil Consumption (SFOC in g/kWh)
Daily Fuel Consumption by Load (metric tonnes/day)
ISO Reference Conditions (42,700 kJ/kg LCV, 1000 mbar, 25C)
Auxiliary Blower Operation & Dual-Fuel (ME-GI / ME-LGI) Gas Heat Rates
sources.geographic_coverage: Global (applicable to all MAN B&W low-speed 2-stroke diesel engines)
sources.historical_coverage: Current engine technical specifications and historical catalog across engine generations
sources.update_frequency: Updated periodically with engine design releases
sources.access_method: Web application and downloadable calculation software
sources.licence_status: Proprietary technical tool; technical specifications intended for maritime project planning

corridor_relevance.PNW-JPN-BULK: VERIFIED (applies to MAN B&W powered Panamax/Kamsarmax/Capesize bulkers)
corridor_relevance.USG-JPN-BULK: VERIFIED (applies to MAN B&W powered Panamax/Kamsarmax/Capesize bulkers)

sources.limitations_and_gaps: Engine manufacturer theoretical testbed curves (Category 4); requires naval architectural hull resistance and propulsion power curves to translate vessel speed (knots) to engine load (kW) in laden and ballast conditions; does not reflect hull fouling or weather margins.

sources.dataset_name: WinGD General Technical Data (GTD) & Engine Project Guides
fields_observed: Daily Fuel Oil Consumption at Sea (MT/day)
Exhaust Gas Flow and Heat Recovery Data
sources.geographic_coverage: Global (applicable to WinGD / Wärtsilä 2-stroke low-speed engines)
sources.access_method: Online web application and PDF Project Guides
sources.licence_status: Proprietary technical documentation for marine engineering
sources.limitations_and_gaps: Theoretical engine performance (Category 4); requires external propulsion power estimation to link vessel sea speed to engine output.

sources.operator: International Maritime Organization (IMO) / Consortium led by CE Delft
sources.dataset_name: Fourth IMO GHG Study 2020 Final Report & Bottom-Up Annexes
fields_observed: Ship Type (Bulk Carrier, Container, Tanker, General Cargo)
Design Speed vs Operational Speed Distribution (knots)
Main Engine Power (kW) and Auxiliary Engine Power (kW)
Specific Fuel Consumption (g/kWh by engine age and tier)
Daily Fuel Consumption by Operational Phase (Sea, Manoeuvring, Berth/Port)
sources.update_frequency: Periodic (approx every 5–6 years; Fourth Study published 2020)
sources.units_and_currency: DWT, knots, kW, g/kWh, MT/day, tonnes CO2
sources.access_method: Public download (Full Study PDF and Supplementary Data Tables)
sources.licence_status: IMO Copyright / Public Document for International Maritime Policy

corridor_relevance.PNW-JPN-BULK: VERIFIED (provides empirical class-level baseline for Panamax 60-99k DWT and Capesize 100-199k DWT)
corridor_relevance.USG-JPN-BULK: VERIFIED (provides empirical class-level baseline for Panamax 60-99k DWT and Capesize 100-199k DWT)

sources.limitations_and_gaps: Generic vessel-class statistical averages (Category 5); cannot represent vessel-specific mechanical condition, eco-electronic engine tuning, or hull coating quality.

sources.operator: Port of Seattle & The Northwest Seaport Alliance (NWSA)
sources.dataset_name: Port of Seattle Terminals Tariff No. 5 & NWSA Tariff No. 300
fields_observed: Item 7000: Dockage Rate Schedule by LOA (Length Overall in feet/meters)
Dockage Assessment Basis: 24-hour periods or fraction thereof
Wharfage Rates by Commodity (Bulk grain, general cargo $/MT)
sources.geographic_coverage: Port of Seattle, Puget Sound, Washington, USA (USSEA)
sources.historical_coverage: Annual tariff revisions (effective January 1 of each calendar year)
sources.units_and_currency: USD ($) per 24 hours (dockage based on LOA), USD per metric ton (wharfage)

corridor_relevance.PNW-JPN-BULK: VERIFIED (authoritative departure port tariff for Seattle)

sources.limitations_and_gaps: Official statutory tariff does not include pilotage (separate Puget Sound Pilots tariff), tug assists (commercial tug company contracts), line handling, or customs agency fees.

sources.dataset_name: Port of Portland Marine Terminals Tariff No. 500
fields_observed: Section 700: Dockage Rates based on LOA (Length Overall in meters)
Wharfage Charges by Commodity (Grain, mineral bulk)
sources.geographic_coverage: Port of Portland, Columbia River, Oregon, USA (USPDX)

corridor_relevance.PNW-JPN-BULK: VERIFIED (authoritative departure port tariff for Portland)

sources.limitations_and_gaps: Does not include dual pilotage fees for Columbia River Bar Pilots (Sea-Astoria) and Columbia River Pilots (Astoria-Portland).

sources.dataset_name: Port of Houston Authority Tariff No. 8
fields_observed: Subrule 073: Dockage Rates based on LOA (Length Overall in feet/meters)
Sheddage and Marginal Track Use Charges
Wharfage Rates on Dry Bulk Cargo
sources.access_method: Public PDF and web tariff publication

corridor_relevance.USG-JPN-BULK: VERIFIED (authoritative departure port tariff for Houston)

sources.limitations_and_gaps: Excludes Houston Pilots Association fees (draft + unit charge), commercial assist tugs, and line handling.

sources.operator: Board of Commissioners of the Port of New Orleans
sources.dataset_name: Port of New Orleans Dock Department Tariff No. 2
fields_observed: Item 100-150: Dockage Charges based on LOA and Gross Registered Tonnage (GRT)
Harbor Fee Assessments based on DWT/GRT categories
Wharfage Charges per Short Ton / Metric Ton
sources.geographic_coverage: Port of New Orleans, Louisiana, USA (USMSY)

corridor_relevance.USG-JPN-BULK: VERIFIED (authoritative departure port tariff for New Orleans)

sources.limitations_and_gaps: Excludes Associated Branch Pilots (Bar) and Crescent River Port Pilots (River) tariffs, and mid-stream grain elevator buoy/barge fleeting charges.

sources.operator: City of Yokohama Port & Harbor Bureau / Port of Yokohama
sources.dataset_name: Port of Yokohama Port Regulations, Port Dues & Berthage Tariff
fields_observed: Port Entry Dues (JPY per Gross Ton / GT)
Berthage Charges (JPY per GT per 24-hour period)
sources.geographic_coverage: Port of Yokohama, Tokyo Bay, Japan (JPYOK)
sources.access_method: Public municipal portal (Japanese and English summary guides)

corridor_relevance.PNW-JPN-BULK: VERIFIED (authoritative destination port tariff for Yokohama)
corridor_relevance.USG-JPN-BULK: VERIFIED (authoritative destination port tariff for Yokohama)

sources.limitations_and_gaps: Excludes Tokyo Bay Pilots Association mandatory pilotage fees (calculated by JPY baseline + GT and draft tiers) and commercial tug line fees; requires USD/JPY exchange rate conversion.

sources.operator: Panama Canal Authority (ACP — Autoridad del Canal de Panamá)
sources.dataset_name: Panama Canal Maritime Regulations & Official Toll Tariff Schedules
fields_observed: Dry Bulk Toll Rate Schedule (Laden rate and Ballast rate per PC/UMS Net Ton)
Fixed Transit Reservation / Booking Fee by Vessel Category (Regular, Super, Neopanamax)
Freshwater Surcharge (FWS): $10,000 fixed fee + variable percentage (1% to 10%) based on daily Gatun Lake water stage
Tugboat Assistance Charges per Lockage (number of tugs determined by beam/LOA)
sources.geographic_coverage: Panama Canal Interoceanic Waterway (Balboa PAPAC / Cristobal)
sources.historical_coverage: Official tariff circulars (Advisories to Shipping No. A-42-2022, A-34-2023, Notice to Shipping N-1-2024 to 2026)
sources.update_frequency: Published statutory circulars and daily Gatun Lake hydrological updates
sources.access_method: Public web portal, official circular PDFs, and ACP Online Toll Calculator
sources.licence_status: Official Panama Canal Authority statutory regulations

corridor_relevance.PNW-JPN-BULK: UNAVAILABLE (transpacific route does not transit Panama Canal)
corridor_relevance.USG-JPN-BULK: VERIFIED (governing canal expense for US Gulf to Japan route)

sources.limitations_and_gaps: Auction slot fees (which surge during drought restrictions) are dynamic market auctions and cannot be predicted from baseline tariff schedules alone.

sources.dataset_name: Suez Canal Navigation Circulars & Toll Tariff Regulations
fields_observed: Suez Canal Net Tonnage (SCNet) Toll Rates by Ship Category
Dry Bulk Carrier Laden vs Ballast Tariffs
Mandatory Escort Tug and Mooring Boat Fees
sources.units_and_currency: Special Drawing Rights (SDR), converted to USD at daily IMF exchange rate
sources.access_method: Public website and official PDF circulars
sources.licence_status: Official Suez Canal Authority regulatory circulars

corridor_relevance.USG-JPN-BULK: PARTIAL (alternative route if Panama Canal is blocked or Cape of Good Hope / Suez routing is selected)

sources.limitations_and_gaps: SDR conversion requires daily IMF exchange rate lookup; geopolitical security surcharges in Red Sea approach are separate commercial war-risk insurance premiums.

sources.dataset_name: EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS) Maritime Directive (EU) 2023/959
fields_observed: Scope: Commercial vessels >= 5,000 GT entering/leaving EU/EEA ports
Surrender Obligations: 40% (2024), 70% (2025), 100% (2026) of verified CO2 emissions
Geographic Multiplier: 100% between EU ports; 50% for inbound/outbound international voyages
Eligible Allowances: European Union Allowances (EUA) in EUR per tonne of CO2
Approved Fuel Emission Factors (tCO2/tFuel: HFO=3.114, LFO=3.151, MGO=3.206, LNG=2.750)
sources.geographic_coverage: European Economic Area voyages and international voyages connecting to EEA ports
sources.update_frequency: Statutory annual compliance cycle; daily EUA carbon price market
sources.units_and_currency: EUR (€) per EUA / metric tonne CO2
sources.access_method: Public European Commission legislation and EEX / ICE carbon market spot feeds

corridor_relevance.PNW-JPN-BULK: UNAVAILABLE (transpacific trade does not touch EU jurisdiction)
corridor_relevance.USG-JPN-BULK: UNAVAILABLE (US Gulf to Japan trade does not touch EU jurisdiction; relevant only for benchmarking global carbon liabilities)

sources.limitations_and_gaps: Requires live EUA carbon spot price feed; not legally applicable to PNW-JPN or USG-JPN corridors unless intermediate port calls in EU territories occur.

fields_observed: Well-to-Wake (WtW) GHG Intensity Target (gCO2eq/MJ of energy used)
Financial Penalty per Energy Deficit: EUR 2,400 per tonne VLSFO equivalent deficit
Mandatory Onshore Power Supply (OPS) at berth for passenger and container vessels
sources.limitations_and_gaps: Does not apply to Pacific bulk trade corridors; establishes emerging regulatory framework for lifecycle alternative bunker economics.
